title: Specialist- People and Culture
description:
**About Udhyam:**


Udhyam Learning Foundation (Udhyam) is on a mission towards Making Bharat Entrepreneurial. We believe that entrepreneurship is a powerful way to channelize an individual’s potential. Entrepreneurship enables agency and allows an individual to work on their strengths while creating value for the world.

 **Our programs:**

* Udhyam Vyapaar focuses on nano businesses in India, and solving large problems faced by them, at scale; having already enabled up to a 27% income uplift for 5000\+ entrepreneurs.


The goal for Udhyam is to build a thriving and supportive ecosystem, where every individual feels empowered to define their own path.

* Udhyam Shiksha works on developing entrepreneurial mindsets among the youth and enabling them to achieve their potential, having impacted \~24,00,000 learners across 12 Indian states.

 **People and Culture at Udhyam:**


Udhyam’s People \& Culture team is the core engine driving it: people are our greatest strength. Our people along with a high focus on building an achievement culture has brought us the success we have seen in the last six years. We strive to create an employee\-AND\-mission\-first culture. This balance \- though challenging, has been highly rewarding.

  

Our principles of autonomy with responsibility, care and fairness that we promote with our customers, is what form the foundation of the culture at Udhyam too. Each one at Udhyam is part of building this culture of trust and high ownership of Udhyam’s vision.

  

The Senior Specialist HRBP role will play a crucial part in managing and overseeing the human resources and administrative functions of Shiksha vertical in the North. This position is based in Delhi/Gurgaon and may require occasional travel to project sites and central office locations (15\-20% of the role).

 **Role and Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Shiksha leaders to understand and address HR needs aligned with program goals
* Induct and enable managers and senior managers across the breadth of Udhyam’s people management processes and philosophy
* Provide guidance on HR policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with state regulations and organisational standards
* Work closely with the central HR team to ensure consistency in HR practices across the organisation
* Participate in the development and implementation of HR policies, procedures, and programs
* Support organisation\-wide initiatives, such as employee engagement, diversity and inclusion, and talent management
* Respond to general queries from managers and employees, signposting them to the appropriate policies and procedures
* Be the first point of contact for all shiksha employee needs including, addressing employee concerns and facilitating conflict resolution
* Identify training needs and facilitate the development of training programs
* Mitigate legal risks by addressing employee relations issues in a fair and consistent manner
* Utilize HR analytics to assess key HR metrics and provide insights for data\-driven decision\-making.
* Collaborate with Shiksha team to create and maintain a positive work culture that fosters growth and engagement
* Hire for Shiksha needs

 **Essential Skills, Experience \& Mindsets :**

* Experience as an HRBP, preferably in the nonprofit sector, with a focus on education initiatives.
* Strong understanding of HR practices, employment legislation, and trends.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships at all levels.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* High degree of ownership and a bias for action with willingness to be hands on \& frugal
* Ability to work with ambiguity and innovative ideas
* Ability to build strong relationships and influence key stakeholders.
* Ability to work with multiple teams and manage specific asks and requirements
* An independent thinker and people problems solver, able to navigate uncertainty
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.
* Willing to travel to different locations like Uttarakhand, MP, Punjab, Maharashtra etc

 **Desirable Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master’s or degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Experience in the areas of Organisational Development , Compensation and benefits, Data analytics and budgeting
* Developing HR strategy and Team management

 **Location:**

**Delhi/ Gurgaon/ Chandigarh/ Dehradun**

title: Job Description – Operations & Customer Support Executive
description:

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Position:** Operations \& Customer Support Executive

We are looking for a responsible and customer\-focused **Operations \& Customer Support Executive** to manage day\-to\-day operational activities, coordinate with students/customers and internal teams, resolve queries, and ensure smooth execution of admission, course, payment, documentation, and support processes.

Key Responsibilities

**Operations**

* Coordinate with **Admissions, Academic, Finance, HR, and Management** teams.
* Maintain and update student/customer records, databases, and operational reports.
* Track admissions, payments, documentation, course access, examinations, and other operational requirements.
* Follow up on pending documents, payments, applications, and customer requests.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Ensure company processes, policies, and SOPs are followed.
* Maintain proper records of customer communications and operational activities.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders whenever required.

**Customer Support**

* Handle customer/student queries through **phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and other communication channels**.
* Provide accurate information regarding courses, admissions, fees, payments, LMS access, examinations, certificates, and related processes.
* Resolve customer complaints and service\-related issues professionally and within the required timeline.
* Follow up with customers regarding pending payments, documents, examinations, assignments, and other requirements.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the concerned department or management.
* Maintain a professional and positive relationship with students, doctors, customers, and partners.
* Ensure timely responses and proper closure of customer queries.

**Coordination \& Follow\-Up**

* Coordinate with the sales/admission team after enrollment to ensure a smooth customer onboarding process.
* Coordinate with academic and examination teams for student requirements.
* Coordinate with finance/accounts regarding payment and outstanding\-related queries.
* Monitor pending cases and ensure timely follow\-up until resolution.
* Maintain proper communication records and update CRM/ERP systems.

Required Skills

* Excellent **communication and interpersonal skills**.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel, MS Word, Google Sheets, email, and CRM systems**.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Customer\-service\-oriented approach.
* Good problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities.
* Good written and verbal English.
* Hindi communication skills will be an advantage.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in **Business Administration, Management, Commerce, or a related field**.
* 1–3 years of experience in **Operations, Customer Support, Customer Success, Administration, or a similar role**.
* Experience in the **education, healthcare, training, or ed\-tech sector** will be preferred.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

* Timely resolution of customer queries.
* Customer satisfaction and service quality.
* Accuracy of operational records and reports.
* Timely completion of follow\-ups.
* Reduction in pending/unresolved cases.
* Coordination efficiency across departments.
* Compliance with company processes and SOPs.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be **organized, proactive, responsible, customer\-friendly, and detail\-oriented**, with the ability to manage operational responsibilities while maintaining excellent customer relationships.

As such, the candidate must be skilled at anticipating problems, creating contingency plans, managing multiple priorities, problem solving and organizing logistics. Key to the position is the ability to keep the team organized, prioritized and on time while also serving as a "go to" for all areas and departments which dovetail with HR. Ensure fair and consistent application of all company policies and compliance with laws and regulations. Take partners or escalate when next steps are unclear.

Participate in talent development and talent management processes with business leadership. Respectfully challenge talent outcomes and ensure business leaders are trained to conduct effective career growth and performance management discussions. title: Senior Program coordinator/ Program Officer - Technical and Operation
description:
Overview:

Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).

**About the Program**


Jhpiego provides strategic technical assistance to the Government of India's National TB Elimination Program (NTEP) to accelerate TB elimination through health systems strengthening, implementation research, digital innovations, and evidence\-based interventions. Working closely with the Central TB Division (CTD), State TB Cells, the National Health Mission (NHM), and development partners, Jhpiego supports the delivery of high\-quality, people\-centered TB services across the continuum of care.
The program implements several national and multi\-state initiatives, including the Pro TB Impact Project, which strengthens TB service delivery at the primary healthcare level by integrating routine TB screening into Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (AAMs) and maternal health services, promoting differentiated care for high\-risk TB patients, and establishing learning labs to generate evidence for scalable interventions. Jhpiego also leads the Cough Syrup Sales Surveillance Initiative, an innovative pharmacy and AYUSH\-linked surveillance model that leverages digital technologies, community engagement, and referral systems to enable early identification of individuals with presumptive TB and ensure timely linkage to diagnostic and treatment services under NTEP.**About the Position**


Jhpiego is seeking a dynamic and motivated professional to support the implementation and coordination of national and state\-level TB initiatives.


The incumbent will provide technical, operational, and program management support across multiple TB projects, ensuring effective implementation in accordance with approved work plans, timelines, donor requirements, and Jhpiego policies. The position requires independent management of assigned workstreams, coordination with government and implementation partners, preparation of high\-quality technical documentation, monitoring of project deliverables, and support for day\-to\-day project operations.


The successful candidate should possess strong organizational, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


Responsibilities:
* **Program Coordination and Implementation Support**
* Independently coordinate selected project activities in line with work plans and timelines.
* Track deliverables, identify risks, and proactively escalate delays with recommended mitigation.
* Provide technical and operational support to field teams to ensure activity quality and adherence to standards.
* Contribute to development of technical briefs, implementation notes, and program presentations.
* 
* **Stakeholder and Relationship Management**
* Liaise with district/state stakeholders, internal teams, and external partners for smooth program execution.
* Build effective working relationships to enable timely communication, joint reviews, and activity follow‑
* Represent the project in selected technical discussions, review meetings, and coordination forums.

* **Meetings, Reviews and Documentation**
* Lead coordination of program meetings, technical reviews, and trainings at national/state/district levels.
* Prepare high‑quality minutes, tracking sheets, action plans, and follow‑up matrices.
* Support development of donor reports (monthly/quarterly/annual), ensuring accuracy and completeness.

* **Operations, Logistics and Finance Coordination**
* Independently handle logistics, and procurement coordination as per organizational
* 
* Track budgets, GRFs, activity expenses, purchase requests, and settlements.
* Maintain updated records of procurements, inventory, and key documentation.

* **Monitoring, Data and Knowledge Management**
* Maintain trackers, dashboards, and databases for monitoring deliverables and program outputs.
* Support data collation and validation from field teams.
* Document learnings, best practices, and case studies to contribute to knowledge management.

* **Other Responsibilities**
* Provide cross\-team coordination support for training, workshops, and reviews.
* Undertake additional tasks aligned with project goals as assigned by the supervisor.


Required Qualifications:
* Master’s in business administration/ post graduate diploma/ master’s in social work/ MA/ MCom/ PG Diploma/ MSc or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of relevant experience in program coordination, project management, or implementation support, preferably in public health or development programs.
* Experience working with donor\-funded projects and government stakeholders is desirable.
* Prior experience with the NTEP or TB\-related programs will be an added advantage.

 **Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong program coordination and ability to independently manage assigned workstreams.
* Result\-oriented mindset with strong follow\-up and closure skills.
* Excellent relationship management and interpersonal communication.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel (trackers), PowerPoint, and Microsoft Office tools.
* Ability to work collaboratively with multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.

  

Jhpiego is an equal opportunity employer and offers a highly dynamic and enabling work environment. Jhpiego offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive employee benefits package. Women candidates are encouraged to apply.

  

Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted applicants will receive a response from Jhpiego HR.

title: Manager - People Services Operations
description:
**ERM** is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organisations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.


The **Global Delivery Centre** (GDC) in Gurugram is ERM’s global operating backbone. It delivers business enablement services in Finance, HR, IT, and Commercial Operations to ensure ERM’s global business runs seamlessly, efficiently, and consistently.


At the GDC, you will:

* Be part of a hub that ensures ERM’s business continuity worldwide.
* Collaborate with colleagues across geographies to support global operations.
* Drive consistency, compliance, and efficiency in core functions.
* Work with digital, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to optimise how ERM operates.
* Work in shifts where required, depending on the role. As processes mature and automation increases, reliance on shifts will reduce.

**1\. Why this role matters?**


As a **People Services Team Lead**, you will support ERM's global delivery by leading the execution of HR operations and employee lifecycle processes while ensuring a consistent, high\-quality service experience for employees and managers globally. You will work within the **People Services team**, partnering with HR Operations, Payroll, Recruitment, Finance, Global Mobility, and business stakeholders across regions to deliver accurate, compliant, and efficient people services. This role is critical to ensuring operational excellence, service quality, process standardization, and scalability of ERM's global people operations model.

**2\. What your impact is?**

* Lead and develop a high\-performing People Services team that consistently delivers excellent service and achieves operational KPIs.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant processing of employee lifecycle transactions across multiple regions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service delivery, efficiency, and employee experience.
* Maintain high levels of data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support effective workload management, SLA adherence, and resolution of escalated employee and manager queries.
* Promote collaboration across HR Operations, Recruitment, Payroll, Finance, and Global Mobility teams to ensure seamless service delivery.

**3\. What you'll bring:**

* 8\+ years of experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, People Services, or Human Resources administration, including team management experience.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong experience managing employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, contractual changes, payroll support, benefits administration, and offboarding.
* Experience working with global HR systems such as Workday, SAP HR, or similar platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to partner effectively across functions and geography.
* Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, and process management skills.
* Strong customer\-service mindset with a commitment to delivering a high\-quality employee experience.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively within service level agreements (SLAs).

**4\. Preferred:**

* Master's degree or MBA in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience working within a professional services organization.
* Exposure to global HR shared services or service centre environments.
* Experience supporting process improvement, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with ticket management platforms such as ManageEngine or similar case management tools.
* Experience working with AI\-enabled tools, workflow automation, or digital HR solutions.

**5\. Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage the People Services team to ensure efficient, accurate, and timely delivery of HR administrative services.
* Monitor team workloads, service levels, and performance metrics to ensure business expectations are met.
* Provide coaching, training, and ongoing development support to People Services Administrators and team members.
* Manage escalations and support resolution of complex employee and manager queries.
* Collaborate with HR Operations teams and business stakeholders to ensure seamless global service delivery.
* Oversee ticket management activities, ensuring adherence to SLAs and appropriate prioritization of work.
* Drive process standardization, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain data integrity and ensure compliance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and operational management of People Services team members.
* Contribute directly to HR transactional activities during peak periods or when additional support is required.
* In\-office during onboarding, followed by a hybrid working model (2\-3 days per week in office).

title: HR Manager
description:
Job Description – HR Manager

Experience: 3–4 Years

Employment Type \- Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and responsible HR Manager to manage day\-to\-day HR operations, payroll, attendance, leave, recruitment, statutory compliance, and employee relations. The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of Indian labour laws, PF \& ESIC, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to use AI tools to improve HR processes.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Payroll Management

\* Manage monthly payroll processing, including salary, deductions, incentives, and overtime.

\* Verify attendance, leave, late fines, and LOP before salary processing.

\* Coordinate with the Accounts Department for timely salary disbursement.

\* Handle employee salary queries and Full \& Final (F\&F) settlements.

2\. Attendance \& Leave Management

\* Monitor daily attendance, late coming, and absenteeism.

\* Manage leave applications, approvals, and leave records.

\* Ensure compliance with company attendance and leave policies.

\* Maintain accurate attendance and leave MIS reports.

3\. Statutory Compliance – PF \& ESIC

\* Manage monthly PF and ESIC\-related compliance and documentation.

\* Coordinate employee registrations, UAN, ECR, challans, and applicable statutory records.

\* Coordinate with PF/ESIC consultants and government authorities when required.

\* Maintain compliance records and ensure timely completion of applicable filings.

4\. Labour Law \& HR Compliance

\* Maintain practical knowledge of Indian labour laws and applicable employment regulations.

\* Implement HR policies as per company requirements and applicable laws.

\* Maintain employee records, statutory registers, and compliance documentation.

\* Support labour inspections, audits, and compliance\-related queries.

5\. Recruitment \& Hiring

\* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment for various departments.

\* Prepare job descriptions, source candidates, screen resumes, and schedule interviews.

\* Coordinate with HODs for manpower requirements and selection.

\* Manage offer letters, joining formalities, onboarding, and induction.

6\. Employee Relations \& Problem Solving

\* Handle employee grievances and workplace\-related concerns professionally.

\* Resolve HR issues through effective communication and practical solutions.

\* Manage disciplinary actions, warning letters, and policy violations as per company policy.

\* Coordinate with management and HODs to resolve employee\-related problems.

7\. AI Tools \& HR Technology

\* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other relevant HR software to improve HR productivity.

\* Utilize AI for drafting HR communications, job descriptions, HR policies, and reports.
